title: Twin Resonance
next_chapter_hook: When the blood-red curtain of truth was torn away, the identity of the executor behind the blood-soaked finale after seven hundred chapters finally revealed its ferocious corner—and in the instant when Chen Ji and Chen Tianming locked eyes, the chessboard of destiny had already flipped.

text.content: On the broken ruins, the blood-red setting sun dyed the horizon a deep crimson. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, his chest heaving violently—the previous Tianji Record foresight had nearly drained all his Heavenly Fate. Yet what chilled him more was the figure lying in his own pool of blood in that vision—the face was unmistakably his own. Beside him, that familiar yet strange silhouette was slowly raising its head, revealing half a face identical to Chen Ji's.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji clenched his jaw, voice hoarse) Chen Tianming... you've finally decided to show yourself? That finale after seven hundred chapters—was it you?

text.content: Ripples formed in the void, and a figure almost identical to Chen Ji materialized from nothingness. Chen Tianming—a name Chen Ji had heard countless times from Mo Xiansheng, yet never imagined meeting like this. Deep within those eyes swirled the same Heavenly Secrets power as Chen Ji's, but with an unfathomable depth he could not comprehend.

dialogue.content: (Chen Tianming spoke softly, voice carrying a complex smile) Little brother... that finale you witnessed wasn't my wish. But fate's script was written long ago—we are both merely pieces on the board.

text.content: Before his words even finished, Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his mind. The sealed 'Tianji Severance' began to tremble on its own, cracks spreading across the blade as if something was trying to break free. At the same time, an ancient and majestic consciousness surged into his Mental Sea like a tide—the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

dialogue.content: (The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, authoritative and cold) Interesting... Two ants, daring to challenge fate's foundation. Chen Tianming, you have betrayed my arrangement.

text.content: Chen Ji shuddered throughout, that pressure crushing every inch of his soul like a physical force. The Heavenly Dao's Eye—that ultimate antagonist only revealed in Volume Eight—had now manifested so directly. Yet Chen Tianming stood before him, that figure identical to himself now radiating absolute resolve.

dialogue.content: (Chen Tianming's gaze fixed on the void, voice calm yet carrying undeniable resolve) I have never betrayed you. I am merely fulfilling my mission—to protect him, as you instructed when you first entrusted me with the Tianji Record.

text.content: Chen Ji froze. Protect? His brother—that twin he had never met was sent to guard him? Mo Xiansheng's words echoed in his mind: 'Each generation of Tianji Record inheritors has another twin serving as lock and guardian.' He had always assumed that referred to Chen Nian, never expecting...

(Chen Tianming turned, meeting Chen Ji's gaze for the first time, their reflections mirroring each other) Chen Ji, we were born from the same source, yet torn apart by fate to opposite ends of the sky. I lived for centuries under the Heavenly Dao's Eye's control, only to wait for this moment—to complete the Twin Resonance with you and break the deadly trap it set.

choice.prompt: Twin Resonance implies profound soul-level integration, but the risks are immense—once control is lost, Chen Ji might completely lose himself. How will you choose?

choices.description: Trust Chen Tianming's protective heart, proactively open the spirit soul to accept Twin Resonance, allowing two streams of Tianji power to merge.
choices.visible_reward: Gain 'Twin Unity' state, sharing Tianji Record vision with Chen Tianming
choices.risk_hint: If resonance fails, spirit soul may suffer severe damage or even collapse

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly closed his eyes. His spirit soul was like a stone door sealed for a millennium, now slowly opening under Chen Tianming's call. A warm, familiar light rose from his heart—that bond of shared blood, a call across seven hundred chapters of destiny.

dialogue.content: (Chen Tianming's voice resonated through the connection, trembling with restrained emotion) I can feel it... your pain, your schemes, your hatred. Little brother, carrying the entire world alone all these years, are you tired?

text.content: In that moment, a crack appeared in Chen Ji's ironclad psychological defenses. After years of playing the fool to吞tiger, he had long forgotten how to confide in others. Yet now, Chen Tianming's consciousness poured into his parched soul like a gentle stream, warm and real. His eyes couldn't help but grow moist.

choices.description: Remain vigilant against the Heavenly Dao's Eye's threats, keep distance from Chen Tianming, only engage in limited soul resonance.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve independent judgment, reduce risk of spirit soul losing control
choices.risk_hint: Incomplete resonance may cause instability in the Tianji Record's functions.

text.content: Chen Ji took a half step back, a complex expression flickering in his eyes. Years of scheming had made it impossible for him to easily trust anyone, even the twin brother standing before him connected by blood. He chose a middle path—limited openness rather than complete surrender.

dialogue.content: (Chen Tianming sensed the distance, a flicker of loss in his eyes, yet quickly came to terms) Very well... Your caution proves these years haven't been lived in vain. But remember, brother, time for us to stand side by side is running out.

text.content: The resonance unfolded in a cautious atmosphere, with Chen Ji acquiring partial deep knowledge of the Tianji Record, but the truth about the finale after seven hundred chapters remained unclear. Chen Tianming seemed to have deliberately withheld some crucial information.

choices.description: Suspecting Chen Tianming has been completely controlled by the Heavenly Eye, forcibly expel his consciousness into the Mental Sea.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 80 Heavenly Fate points for Mental Sea confrontation
choices.visible_reward: Maintain absolute Mental Sea independence, eliminate risk of being controlled
choices.risk_hint: May completely offend Chen Tianming, losing an important ally

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned cold, the power of the Tianji Record stirring tumultuous waves in his Mental Sea. He didn't trust any power beyond complete control—even his twin brother. Who knew if this "Chen Tianming" before him was another trap laid by the Heavenly Eye?

dialogue.content: (Chen Tianming was struck by the repulsive force, stumbling backward, shock and heartache interweaving in his eyes) Brother... You're indeed still that Chen Ji who doesn't easily trust anyone. Good, this is good too—at least it proves you survived.

text.content: After the forcible expulsion ended, Chen Ji's Mental Sea trembled violently. Though he maintained independence, he clearly felt something extremely important had been permanently lost in the confrontation—the trust from his brother, and the key to revealing the truth of the finale.

The resonance—or rather, the aftershock of choice—had not yet subsided when a light laugh suddenly echoed through the Void. That laugh carried a playful tone, yet made everyone present feel pressure like towering mountains. A figure stepped out slowly from the torn Void, robes fluttering, bearing transcendent, surrounded by faint starlight.

dialogue.content: (The newcomer surveyed the surroundings, his gaze finally settling on Chen Ji and Chen Tianming, a meaningful smile playing at his lips) The little servant of the Tianqing Sect, and this one... the forgotten grave keeper. The twin's drama is more fascinating than I anticipated. Allow me to introduce myself—Cang Yutian, the "Heavenly Chess Player" you speak of, here today to observe this game.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Cang Yutian—this name he had seen in the fragments left by Mo Xiansheng, yet never imagined encountering under such circumstances. According to records, this person was the agent of the Heavenly Eye in the mortal realm, specifically responsible for "cleansing" those variables that deviated from the path of destiny.

dialogue.content: (Chen Tianming stepped protectively before Chen Ji, his tone frosty) Cang Yutian, you shouldn't appear here. The chess game of destiny hasn't reached its final move—your premature interference has already violated the rules.

text.content: Cang Yutian's smile deepened upon hearing this. He casually raised his hand, chaotic light凝聚ing at his fingertips, within which countless scenes flickered—precisely everything Chen Ji had experienced across seven hundred chapters: from a Tianqing Sect servant to the shadowy manipulator stirring winds across three sects, every scheme and instance of feigning weakness.

dialogue.content: (Cang Yutian observed Chen Ji with amusement) Rules? Chen Tianming, we both know that so-called rules are merely the chessboard designed by the Heavenly Eye. And this little mouse... every step he has taken is recorded in my ledger.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his spine still straight despite his depleted Heavenly Fate. Years of feigning weakness had made him accustomed to finding生机 in desperation. Cang Yutian was undoubtedly powerful, but his words had already revealed crucial information—the Heavenly Eye was not omnipotent, otherwise why would there be a need to "record"?

dialogue.content: (A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, his voice calm yet sharp) Since Senior Cang Yutian came to "watch the game," he surely wouldn't play casually. After all... if you personally make a move, this little mouse might just bite back.

text.content: Cang Yutian squinted, seemingly quite surprised by Chen Ji's reaction. His examining gaze lingered on Chen Ji momentarily before he actually withdrew the chaotic light. The surrounding pressure suddenly diminished, but that feeling of being watched by a fierce beast did not vanish.

dialogue.content: (Cang Yutian gave a light laugh) Interesting. The Heavenly Eye was right—you are indeed the most intriguing variable in a thousand years. But I came here today solely to observe—Chen Tianming, the truth you should tell him, you might as well say it now. The countdown of destiny has already begun.

text.content: Chen Tianming's form stiffened slightly. He turned to look at Chen Ji, those eyes identical to Chen Ji's flickering with complex emotions—reluctance, guilt, and an even deeper bone-penetrating desolation.

dialogue.content: (Chen Tianming took a deep breath, his voice low) Chen Ji, the finale you witnessed... the figure standing beside you as you lay in ruins—that was me, no one else. And killing you... was to save you.

text.content: This sentence struck like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He stared intently at Chen Tianming's face, attempting to find any trace of deception in that countenance so similar to his own. Yet what he saw was only profound, bone-deep sorrow, and a kind of resolve he could not comprehend.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice was tight) "Save me? How is killing me with your own hands saving me? Chen Tianming, you'd better give me a reason convincing enough, otherwise..."

(Chen Tianming gave a bitter smile) "Because at that moment, you had been completely locked onto by the Heavenly Eye. Any struggle would be futile. The only path to survival... was for me, the 'forgotten grave keeper,' to personally end your fate, allowing you to be reborn with a brand new identity. And that 'brand new identity'—was Chen Nian."

text.content: A thunderclap echoed in Chen Ji's mind. Chen Nian—his sister who had been missing for years, the existence taken by the Holy Sect as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' was actually... his own reborn body? At this moment, all the mysteries were linked together by an invisible hand, piecing together a chilling picture.

(Chen Tianming reached out and gently touched Chen Ji's forehead) "This is the ultimate truth of Twin Resonance—you and I were originally one, split into three by fate: Chen Ji, Chen Tianming, Chen Nian. Three identities, three lives, yet only one can survive. The deadly trap designed by the Heavenly Eye is to have us slaughter each other until only one remains... and I choose, for you to live."

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming's revelation left Chen Ji in unprecedented shock. The truth of three souls being one was too horrifying, and Cang Yutian was watching coldly from the side—how will you respond to this sudden truth of fate?

choices.description: Understand Chen Tianming's painstaking efforts, accept this cruel fate arrangement, and let your brother complete his mission.
choices.visible_cost: Lose one identity, Chen Nian returns to the本体
choices.visible_reward: Gain Chen Tianming's complete knowledge inheritance from the Tianji Record, permanently enhancing foresight ability
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may take the opportunity to intervene

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, two streams of clear tears sliding down his cheeks. He remembered those blurry fragments from the Tianji Record—Chen Nian's lonely figure in the heavenly prison, the sister he had sworn to find. So she had been by his side all along, existing in another form.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice was hoarse) "Brother... I'm sorry. I searched for her for so long, yet I didn't know she was part of myself." Chen Tianming smiled bitterly, raising his hand to wipe away the tears on Chen Ji's face, the gesture as gentle as when they were still children.

text.content: (Chen Tianming said softly) "Silly brother, what do you think my hundreds of years of vigil have been for? Seeing you become capable of standing alone, able to lay out chess games in chaotic times that no one can break... I knew then that the path I chose was not wrong."

choices.description: Chen Ji does not accept anyone's sacrifice arranged for him; he will shatter this deadly trap with his own hands.
choices.visible_reward: Activate the 'Reverse Fate' branch line; upgrade Tianji Record function to allow foresight of deadly crises and attempts to evade them
choices.risk_hint: May completely enrage the Heavenly Eye, triggering the final battle prematurely

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, those pupils burning with unprecedented light. He reached out and grabbed Chen Tianming's wrist, the force almost enough to crush bone.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice was low and firm) "I, Chen Ji, have been scheming against the world for seven hundred chapters. When have I ever been the one to be plotted against? When has fate ever been allowed to arrange my ending? Brother, you want to sacrifice yourself—I won't stop you—but that's your own choice, not my destiny."

text.content: In the instant those words fell, the Tianji Record Fragment inside Chen Ji went into frenzied vibration. The residual soul left by Mo Xiansheng actually awakened on its own; an ancient voice rang out in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "Good... good lad! The Tianji Record has waited eight hundred years for this day!"

choices.description: Before making a decision, Chen Ji needs to know all the truth—including Cang Yutian's true purpose.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 points of Heavenly Fate for divination
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence: the true relationship between Cang Yutian and the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: might expose the source of intelligence he possesses

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Cang Yutian's arrival was too coincidental—he had to determine whether this "Chess Observer" was friend or foe. He turned to face the figure radiating starlight, his eyes flickering with shrewd calculations.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji slightly cupped his hands, his tone calm) Since Cang Yutian the Elder has made a special appearance, surely it's not merely to watch the show. You just said "the countdown of destiny has begun"—I would ask, is this countdown part of the Heavenly Eye's plan, or... your own plan?

text.content: Cang Yutian's gaze slightly shifted, seemingly unprepared for Chen Ji's direct questioning. Beside him, Chen Tianming's pupils constricted, as if suddenly comprehending something. And in the depths of the heavens, that invisible "Heavenly Eye" seemed to slowly open...

As the atmosphere reached its most tense moment, a clear sword cry suddenly echoed from the distance. Within that cry was an aura achingly familiar to Chen Ji—Su Qingyao's sword intent. The cold and凌厉 aura of the Tianqing Sect Inner Disciple Senior Fellow was rapidly approaching, accompanied by several unfamiliar yet powerful auras.

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao's voice came from afar, carrying suppressed anxiety) Chen Ji! Where are you? The Tianqing Sect Outer Court is under attack, Ling Yuan the old villain led Xuanwu Sect masters to encircle us—run!

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes darkened abruptly. Ling Yuan—that Tianqing Sect Old Master who outwardly sheltered him but secretly harbored malicious intentions—had struck at this precise moment. And the timing was so precise, as if he had known long ago that Chen Ji would appear here. Cang Yutian's "chess watching" was clearly not that simple.

(Chen Tianming's voice rang in Chen Ji's ear, tinged with urgency) Brother, it seems our time is even shorter than anticipated. Cang Yutian lured Ling Yuan here to interrupt everything before you complete the resonance. What he serves... is never the Heavenly Eye, but some far more ancient existence.

dialogue.content: (Cang Yutian stood with hands behind his back, his smile growing more provocative) Chen Tianming, you truly are not gentlemanly. Revealing my greatest secret makes this chess game rather dull. However, fine... Chen Ji, I'll give you a choice. Come with me now, and I'll guarantee your survival in the coming chaos; stay here, and you'll face Ling Yuan, the Xuanwu Sect, and... your own heart demon.

text.content: Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings. Su Qingyao's aura drew ever closer, yet was also being surrounded by more enemy auras. Chen Tianming hovered weakly in mid-air, the resonance having already consumed most of his strength. Deep in the heavens, the Heavenly Eye's gaze grew increasingly clear, like an invisible giant hand slowly tightening.

(Chen Ji slowly straightened, a familiar cold smile curling his lips) Cang Yutian the Elder, I appreciate your kindness. But this Chen Ji has never needed anyone to show him the way. If Ling Yuan the old villain wants to come, let him come. I've walked through seven hundred chapters of lethal traps—am I supposed to fear one hiding, hypocritical villain?

Cang Yutian's smile stiffened slightly. He scrutinized those ink-black eyes of Chen Ji, seeing within them something that even made him uneasy—an otherworldly tranquility, a composure that transcended life and death. This servant disciple was far more terrifying than he had imagined.

dialogue.content: (Cang Yutian suppressed his smile, his voice low) Interesting. Then I'll watch with anticipation to see if this little mouse can really bite the elephant to death. But Chen Ji... remember my counsel: the Heavenly Eye is not the final destination—above you stand even older chess players. And I... am considering whether to become your ally.

text.content: Before the words even finished, Cang Yutian's form had already scattered into countless starlights dissolving into the Void. The suffocating pressure vanished abruptly, yet Chen Ji did not lower his guard. This "Heavenly Chess Player" had hidden far too much information he had yet to decipher within his words. But now was not the time for deep contemplation.
(Chen Tianming smiled weakly) Brother, it seems this ordeal today can only be overcome by yourself. I need time to recover, otherwise... Cang Yutian's true purpose, we may never know.

Chen Ji nodded, his mind moving. A strand of light emerged from the Tianji Record Fragment and收纳 his consciousness back within. Master Mo's voice arose within his Mental Sea: "Young man, though the resonance was interrupted, you've already obtained crucial information. Next... this old one will teach you another lifesaving divine technique."

The moment the words fell, an immense stream of information flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. It was an extremely exquisite breath-suppressing technique, capable of completely concealing Heavenly Fate fluctuations and Tianji Record aura within a short time. Even beings at Cang Yutian's level would find it difficult to detect without careful investigation.

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao's figure finally appeared within his vision, her sword qi vertical and horizontal as she forced back several black-clad figures. Seeing Chen Ji unharmed, her tense features slightly relaxed) You're still alive... that's great. Ling Yuan the old villain is just ahead, I'll hold him off, you go first!

text.content: Chen Ji looked at this woman who had both hunted and protected him throughout the journey, a complex emotion welling within his heart. Three times approaching the truth, three times resolved by him—this woman's obsession with him sometimes even moved him. Yet now she was willing to hold back an enemy of Ling Yuan's level for his sake.

(Chen Ji slightly shook his head, his voice calm yet carrying indomitable resolve) Senior Sister Su, I appreciate your kindness. But Ling Yuan is my destined nemesis—this battle... must be fought by myself. Just help me hold back the others.

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao gritted her teeth, her sword eyebrows tightly furrowed) You... you waste, with not a shred of cultivation, still want to show off what strength? Ling Yuan is an old monster at Gold Core late stage, what do you have to fight him with?

text.content: Chen Ji offered no answer. He merely slightly raised his right hand, the Tianji Record Fragment faintly glowing within his sleeve. A scene only Su Qingyao could see flashed through her Mental Sea—a fatal flaw in Ling Yuan, a weakness sufficient to allow even a Foundation Building cultivator to slay him with a single strike.

Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply. The scene was too clear, too vivid to seem like foresight rather than... personal observation. Her gaze toward Chen Ji now held emotions she herself could not explain. This servant disciple had indeed been hiding something all along.

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao took a deep breath, finally stepping back) Fine... I'll trust you this once. But if you dare die here, I, Su Qingyao, swear—even if I must pursue you to the Yellow Springs, I'll drag out your soul to question!

text.content: With that, Su Qingyao turned and swung her sword, sword qi like a rainbow, instantly clearing a vacuum zone within the battlefield. Her silhouette was decisive, yet carried a subtle tremor—something undetectable to others. It was the first time she had chosen to "believe" in a man she had pursued for three years, yet never truly understood.

Chen Ji gazed at Su Qingyao's retreating figure, a faint smile curving his lips. This woman was finally learning to trust him. Though their relationship remained complicated, at least in this battle, she stood beside him as an ally, not an enemy.

In the distant horizon, an aura of old age and cold malevolence approached. It was Ling Yuan—the former Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect, once a candidate for the Tianji Record's inheritance, cast aside. For this moment, he had endured for decades. Today, he would personally crush this wretch who had stolen his destiny into powder.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan's figure appeared above the ruins, gazing down at Chen Ji from above, his voice sinister) Little wretch, did you think hiding here would save you from your fate? This old man has waited for this day for a very long time.

text.content: Chen Ji lifted his head, meeting Ling Yuan's eyes filled with hatred and greed. This old monster had once been a candidate for the Tianji Record's inheritance, yet was abandoned by the Tianji Record due to 'insufficient talent'. Now he had colluded with the Xuanwu Sect, vowing to seize the Tianji Record Fragment and rewrite his own destiny.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji smiled faintly, his voice terrifyingly calm) Senior Ling Yuan, you've finally arrived. I've been waiting... for a very long time as well.

text.content: Ling Yuan's pupils contracted slightly. This wretch's reaction was far too calm. Too calm, giving him an unsettling feeling. But he quickly suppressed this emotion - what could a Qi Refining cultivator possibly do? Behind him stood the entire Xuanwu Sect!

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan coldly smiled) Still mouthing off even at death's door. This old man would like to see if that so-called backing of yours will come to save you! Attack!

text.content: With Ling Yuan's command, several black shadows simultaneously lunged toward Chen Ji. At the same time, Ling Yuan himself raised his right hand, and a spiritual technique condensing all his Golden Core stage cultivation crashed down violently. With this strike, he was determined to completely erase Chen Ji, leaving no remnants.

However, just as that mountain-shattering spiritual technique was about to touch Chen Ji, a brilliant sword light cut across the sky, severing the attack like a galaxy pouring down. Su Qingyao's figure stood before Chen Ji, her long sword crossed before her chest, her sword intent fierce enough to nearly tear apart the heavens.

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao spoke coldly, her voice like ice) Ling Yuan old thief, you dare touch someone of the Tianqing Sect—have you asked my sword first?

text.content: Ling Yuan's expression turned as gloomy as dripping water. Su Qingyao—the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect, a genius at the early Golden Core stage. Under normal circumstances, he naturally had no fear. But with her blocking Chen Ji, killing that wretch quickly would not be so easy.

(Chen Ji stood behind Su Qingyao, his gaze always fixed on Ling Yuan. He slowly spoke, his voice soft but clearly reaching everyone's ears) Senior Sister Su, thank you. But Ling Yuan is my prey—his head, I will take with my own hands.

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao glanced back at Chen Ji, her eyes showing surprise, confusion, but more of an inexplicable trust) ...You're mad. But I believe in you.

text.content: Su Qingyao sheathed her sword and stepped back, yet maintained a posture ready to assist at any moment. Ling Yuan's expression grew increasingly gloomy as he stared at Chen Ji's composed appearance, his unease intensifying. This wretch... what底气 did he have to speak such words to him?

(Chen Ji took a step forward, the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve faintly glowing. Mo Xiansheng's taught concealment technique perfectly hid his aura, leaving him appearing to Ling Yuan as nothing more than a Qi Refining stagetrash) Senior Ling Yuan, being abandoned by the Tianji Record back then—surely you felt quite unwilling about that, didn't you?

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan's face changed dramatically, madness and hatred flickering in his pupils) Silence! You thief who stole the Tianji Record—what right do you have to mention this! This old man sacrificed so much hard work to obtain it back then, you have no idea!

text.content: Chen Ji chuckled lightly, the smile carrying a mix of mockery and pity. He slowly raised his right hand, and a complex pattern of heavenly secrets emerged in his palm. The pattern emanated an ancient and mysterious aura—it was the unique mark of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice was calm) Senior Ling Yuan, you're mistaken about the Tianji Record. It didn't abandon you—rather, you... were never qualified to bear its weight. Look at your current state—colluding with external enemies, betraying your sect, sparing no cost to satisfy your selfish desires at the expense of the entire Tianqing Sect. If the Tianji Record had chosen you, it would have been truly blind.

text.content: Ling Yuan's chest heaved violently, nearly choking with rage at Chen Ji's words. He had cultivated for hundreds of years—when had anyone ever humiliated him so face-to-face? And this humiliation came from a wretch he deemed worthless!

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan erupted in fury, his spiritual pressure surging around him) Sharp-tongued thing! Today this old man will teach you what it means to be beyond the heavens and the earth!

text.content: Just as Ling Yuan erupted with his attack, a sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's pupils. The Tianji Record's foresight ability was activated to its extreme—he saw the trajectory of Ling Yuan's strike, saw his flaw, and saw... the only opportunity for survival in this battle.

It was an extremely hidden weakness, concealed within Ling Yuan's raging tempest-like offensive. If he fought head-on, Chen Ji would surely die. But if he could seize that fleeting flaw in the space between lightning and fire...

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's killing technique was already inches away—you had only an instant to choose how to respond. How will you seize this life-or-death opportunity?

choices.text: Gamble everything on a single strike, directly targeting the flaw.
choices.description: Trust the Tianji Record's foresight, stake everything, and directly strike Ling Yuan's fatal weakness.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 30 Heavenly Fate to perform extreme foresight
choices.visible_reward: A single strike severely wounds Ling Yuan, completely reversing the battle situation
choices.risk_hint: If the foresight fails, one will be crushed to dust by Ling Yuan's assault

text.content: Chen Ji's body moved the instant Ling Yuan's spiritual technique was about to touch him. His movement was bizarre beyond measure, completely incompatible with the agility a Qi Refining cultivator should possess. This was an extreme foresight transcending flesh, the only lifeline in a death trap exchanged by the Tianji Record with the cost of Heavenly Fate.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji shouted in a low voice) Right here! His voice wasn't loud, yet it was terrifyingly precise.

text.content: A faint glow emanated from Chen Ji's fingertip, carving a tiny crack in Ling Yuan's protective spiritual light. Just one crack, yet it caused a momentary stagnation in Ling Yuan's spiritual technique's operation. And in that instant, Su Qingyao's sword had already arrived.

choices.text: Borrow the power of Chen Tianming
choices.description: Awaken Chen Tianming from his slumber and utilize the residual power of Twin Resonance.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Tianming falls into a deeper slumber and cannot assist again in the short term
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a temporary Twin Power bonus, raising Attack Power to the peak of Foundation Building
choices.risk_hint: Risk permanently losing Chen Tianming as an ally

text.content: Chen Ji's mind stirred, sending a call to Chen Tianming slumbering deep in his Mental Sea. After a moment, a warm power surged from the depths of his soul, merging with his meridians. That was the residual power of Twin Resonance - faint, yet sufficient to let him unleash combat power far beyond his actual cultivation level for a short time.

dialogue.content: (Chen Tianming's voice echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, weak yet resolute) Brother... use my power. Remember this sensation. One day, we shall fight side by side...

text.content: Chen Ji felt the familiar power surging through his body, a slight smile curving his lips. He knew this was the power Chen Tianming exchanged for slumber, and also his brother's trust in him.

choices.text: Let Su Qingyao finish it off
choices.description: Deliberately expose a flaw, lure Ling Yuan into revealing more openings, and let Su Qingyao deliver the fatal strike.
choices.visible_cost: Suffer minor injuries, but successfully conceal part of the Tianji Record's abilities
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's trust in Chen Ji greatly increases, unlocking the 'Fight Side by Side' state
choices.risk_hint: Risk giving Ling Yuan a chance to escape

text.content: A subtle smirk played on Chen Ji's lips. He deliberately slowed his steps, offering Ling Yuan an opening in his assault. The old monster took the bait as expected, its spiritual technique growing more fierce—and more exposed. That was exactly what he wanted.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao had been observing Chen Ji's movements all along. When she saw the flaw Chen Ji deliberately exposed, her heart startled, but quickly understood his intent. This man... from the very beginning, had been calculating every single one of Ling Yuan's movements. She did not hesitate, her sword intent surging violently.

text.content: (Su Qingyao's voice rang in Chen Ji's ear, carrying a complex emotion) Clever scheme... Chen Ji, just how many secrets are you still hiding?

Su Qingyao's sword light descended like the Milky Way falling, carrying the full cultivation of a Golden Core cultivator, striking directly for Ling Yuan's vitals. That single strike poured forth her trust in Chen Ji, and her fury against the traitor. Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply—he never expected this waste to have bound Su Qingyao so completely.
(Ling Yuan roared) Su Qingyao! You ungrateful girl, betraying the Tianqing Sect for atrash? His voice carried incredulous rage.

Su Qingyao gave no answer. Her sword had already given the answer. Fierce sword intent tore through Ling Yuan's protective spiritual light, leaving a deep wound on his shoulder that exposed bone. Blood splashed, staining Ling Yuan's aged face red, and staining that ruins red as well.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan stumbled backward, his face full of disbelief) How is this possible... An elder like me was actually defeated by these two juniors...

text.content: Chen Ji walked slowly toward Ling Yuan, his footsteps echoing distinctly in the silent battlefield. His face held no joy of victory, only an almost cold tranquility. This expression terrified Ling Yuan more than any mockery.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji crouched down, meeting the disheveled Ling Yuan's gaze) Elder Ling Yuan, you have lost. Not in cultivation, but in vision. You spent a lifetime pursuing what was never yours, unaware that true strength... can never be seized.

text.content: A frenzied hatred flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes. He abruptly pulled out a jet-black talisman from his sleeve—a desperate trump card gifted by the Holy Sect: the 'Soul-Rending Talisman'. Even in death, he would drag Chen Ji down with him!

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan grinned savagely) Want to kill this old man? Dream on! Even if I perish here, I will make you both pay!

text.content: The Soul-Rending Talisman's power surged violently within Ling Yuan, tearing apart his final vitality. The force was so violent that even the surrounding space twisted. Su Qingyao's face drained of color, sensing the terrifying energy within that talisman—destructive power capable of flattening hundreds of miles.

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao shouted urgently) Chen Ji! Retreat quickly! That's a Soul-Rending Talisman—once detonated, we'll all die!

text.content: Yet Chen Ji remained utterly still. He gazed quietly at that wildly
